8 Moreover, it is common these days for a single company, such as
Google, to offer cellular plans, provide location services, maintain payment
systems, host shopping platforms, and more. Companies have incentives
to aggregate a user's data across these services, and this tendency will
further complicate any efforts to draw Fourth Amendment lines among
different sorts of third-party records.
